name: Oogiku Jun
source:
The proprietor of a quaint little tobacco shop, but beneath this modest facade, Jun is a wealthy figure firmly holding the town's reins of power. 

A man of homosexual orientation.

Jun is someone who always shows care and concern for Isamu and Mayuko.
